limitations.text: No image is proposed because the searches and inspected pages did not establish a specific 等 glyph image with usable identity and reuse provenance. Xiaoxuetang’s official rights notice permits CC0 use of query-interface glyph images and glyph-attribute information, but the specific 等 record image could not be retrieved. The opened chardb material is evidence only and is not proposed as an image asset.

The paleographic PDF identifies Baoshan and other manuscript forms in its discussion, but a PDF reference to a form is not itself a verified, separately reusable glyph image candidate. The Baoshan museum page supplies artifact context only.
